description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Pipe geometry and inlet/outlet, material, size and flow-direction attributes describe drainage serving the Foothills Trail. The native layer exposes polyline geometry and named attributes, including USE_, PROPERTY_O, MAINTENANC, SHAPE_1, SIZE_WIDTH, SIZE_HEIGH. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for network flow studies. Only drainage directly associated with this trail is included; hydraulic calibration and operating measurements are not established. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
